title: The dal that spilled
body: Asha's grandmother was cooking dal in a pressure cooker. Midway through, she noticed that the dal had spilled out through the lid and made a mess on the stove. She wondered why this had happened. She guessed that she had put too much water in the cooker. The next day, she cooked the same amount of dal in the same cooker on the same stove, but this time with less water. The dal did not spill out.
